kb_articles.title: How to start a return
kb_articles.body: Start a return from Orders > Return item. A prepaid label is emailed within one hour. Returns are free for Plus members; standard members pay a 6 dollar label fee.

kb_articles.title: Changing a shipping address
kb_articles.body: Addresses can be changed only while an order is processing. Once an order ships, contact the carrier with the tracking number.

kb_articles.title: Plus membership
kb_articles.body: Plus membership costs 49 dollars per year and includes free returns and free standard shipping on all orders.

kb_articles.title: Shipping times
kb_articles.body: Standard shipping takes 3-6 business days in the US and 4-8 business days in the EU. Orders placed before noon ship the same day.

kb_articles.title: Damaged items
kb_articles.body: If an item arrives damaged, reply with a photo within 7 days of delivery and we will send a replacement at no cost.

kb_articles.title: Cancelling an order
kb_articles.body: Orders can be cancelled while processing. Cancelled orders are refunded automatically within 3 business days.

kb_articles.title: Gift cards
kb_articles.body: Gift cards never expire and cannot be redeemed for cash. Lost gift cards can be replaced with proof of purchase.

kb_articles.title: Price adjustments
kb_articles.body: If an item's price drops within 14 days of purchase, Plus members can request the difference as store credit.
